services.desc: Please note: Our website is undergoing maintenance and is in the process of being updated. The Long Ride Home: Black Cowboys in America will feature color photographs made by the Philadelphia artist Ron Tarver, challenging the whitewashed myth of the all-American cowboy and deconstructing ideas of Black identity. Taken in the 1990s, Tarver’s images offer testimony to the lived experiences of a thriving community, offering insightful glimpses into the lives of Black people embodying their Western cultural heritage.
